name: set_folder_metadata
description: Creates or updates a metadata template instance on a folder (POST when the template is not yet applied, PUT JSON Patch when it is). Use list_metadata_templates and get_metadata_template_schema first for scope, template_key, and field keys. Same tool handles both first-time application and updates. Does not apply to the root folder (ID "0").

folder_id.description: Box folder ID for the folder to attach or update metadata on. Root folder "0" is not supported.

scope.description: Metadata template scope: use list_metadata_templates to discover (enterprise or global).

metadata_fields.description: Field keys and values for this template. Use get_metadata_template_schema for valid field keys. Values must match the template (strings, numbers, or string arrays as required).
